title: Goldfish wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- fish body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#ff9a1f'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='18' ry='9' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 62 Q4 44 6 62 Q4 80 20 62 Z' fill='#ff8c00' stroke='#ffc16b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- top fin -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q48 28 60 40 Q50 44 38 42 Z' fill='#ffb347' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bottom fin -->
  <path d='M42 83 Q52 92 62 83 Q52 86 42 83 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- side fin -->
  <path d='M52 66 Q60 70 58 78 Q50 74 52 66 Z' fill='#ffb347' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='6' fill='#fff8e7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='56' r='3.2' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='55' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M76 64 Q79 66 76 68' stroke='#b35c00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gill line -->
  <path d='M58 50 Q56 62 58 72' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M40 34 L50 8 L62 32 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <path d='M40 34 L50 8 L62 32 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d='M44 24 L58 26' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M47 16 L55 17' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hat pompom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffe066' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='33' rx='12' ry='3.5' fill='#f25c6b'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='40' r='3' fill='none' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='2' fill='none' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
